The [[Nilash system/Legends|Nilash system]] was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nilash III]].
